headline: Meta launches Direct messaging app for Instagram in two countries
summary: Meta introduced Direct, a standalone messaging app for Instagram, for now available only in Turkey and Thailand and usable with or without an Instagram account. Reports differ on whether the app has fully launched or is still being tested.
